tax.profit.ivao_rate.note: IVAO: tax on operational revenue for eligible SMEs, in place of profit tax.

tax.dividend.rate.note: Rises to 0.08 for profits GENERATED from 2027 under the approved 2027 reform. This is a profit-vintage rule, not a payment-date rule.

tax.vat.registration_threshold.note: CORRECTED. Raised from MDL 1,200,000 to MDL 1,500,000 with effect from 1 January 2026 (art. 112 para (1) and (4)). Raised again to MDL 1,700,000 from 1 March 2026 — see md-2026.2. Measured over the last 12 consecutive months, not a calendar year, so an entity can cross it at any point.

tax.vat.deduction_requires_electronic_in.note: Art. 102 para (18), which restricted the right to deduct VAT on a non-electronic invoice issued by a supplier on the mandatory e-Factura list, is ABROGATED from 1 January 2026. So from 2026 a paper invoice from a list-obligated supplier no longer costs the buyer its deduction. This materially reduces the commercial pressure to adopt e-Factura and must not be modelled as a blocking validation.

tax.vat.refund_ceiling_efactura_or_mev.note: VAT refund ceiling reportedly raised from 20% to 70% for taxpayers using e-Factura and/or MEV-connected cash registers. Reported by secondary sources and NOT found in the Ministry of Finance summary of the 2026 changes — confirm before quoting it to a customer, because it is the strongest positive incentive we have.

efactura.obligation.basis.text: art. 117 para (1^1) risk-based list; art. 117 para (14) since 2025-01-01
efactura.obligation.basis.note: There is NO universal B2B mandate in force. Obligation arises three ways: B2G/public procurement; supplies to economic agents on Moldovan territory without fiscal relations with the budget system (art. 117(14), since 1 January 2025); and inclusion on the SFS risk-based list published at sfs.md. The list is small — reported at 69 entities.

efactura.mandatory_list.selection_min_cr.note: An entity is added when SFS risk analysis finds it meets at least 3 of 8 criteria simultaneously.

efactura.mandatory_list.significant_supp.note: One of the 8 criteria: supplies of at least MDL 500,000 monthly without matching material or human assets.

payroll.income_tax.personal_deduction_in.note: Above this annual gross income the personal deduction is not available.

payroll.cnas.employer_rate.note: Private sector, including state and municipal enterprises, non-commercial organisations and public education and medical institutions.

payroll.cnas.employee_rate.note: RESOLVED. Since 1 January 2021 state social insurance contributions are paid entirely by the employer, so there is no general employee share. The 6% figure that circulates in secondary sources applies only to specific categories (daily remuneration for certain workers) and must be modelled as a category-specific exception, not a general rate.

itpark.single_tax.rate.note: Replaces profit tax, payroll income tax, CNAS and CNAM. VAT applies separately. From 1 January 2026 local taxes, property tax and road tax are excluded from the single tax and paid separately.

itpark.single_tax.min_per_employee_month.note: Approximately 35% of the forecast average wage, per full-time employee. Recomputed annually.

filing.tva12.due_day_of_month.note: Shifts to the next working day when the 25th is a weekend or holiday.

document.factura_fiscala.form_order.note: Strict-regime standardised form with state-issued series and number.

register.general_invoice_register.in_for.note: RESOLVED. Art. 118^1 of the Fiscal Code, which required invoices above MDL 100,000 to be registered in the Registrul general electronic al facturilor fiscale within 10 working days under penalty of MDL 3,600 each, has been ABROGATED. Do not implement it.
